title: Imu Uses Domi Reversi in One Piece Episode 1180 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1180, showing Imu using the skill Domi Reversi while facing the giants. This will be the final episode of the year. The anime returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island.
author: Anime Corner

title: Space Battleship Yamato Film Director Toshio Masuda Dies at 98
content: Newspapers Mainichi Shimbun and Yomiuri Shimbun both reported on Thursday that film director and screenwriter Toshio Masuda died of old age on August 26. He was 98. Masuda was born in Kobe in October 1927.

title: Toshio Masuda, Director of 'Uchuu Senkan Yamato' Movies, Dies at 98
content: Toshio Masuda , the director behind Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) movies, died on August 26 due to natural causes. He was 98. The Directors Guild of Japan announced the news on Thursday, stating that Masuda died at a hospital in Tokyo. A private funeral service has been held by his close relatives.
